item.title: Quiet Quality-of-Life Wins in Vue 3.5
item.content:encoded: Vue 3.5 was a minor release, but it came with some nice quality-of-life upgrades worth exploring. Here’s what one Vue developer uses daily.

item.title: Enhancing Blazor User Experience with Prebuilt Editors
item.content:encoded: These editor-like components can help you improve the user experience of your Blazor application, with settings and customizations that adapt to the scenario you need.

item.title: Understanding AI Agents
item.content:encoded: As an AI engineer (the new full-stack developer), you need to understand an agent’s components through task execution, plus how the system retains progress and coordinates the work.

item.title: Build This Secret Santa UI in .NET MAUI
item.content:encoded: Let’s practice our .NET MAUI skills by creating this fun Secret Santa app.

item.title: Better Auth with Nuxt and SQLite
item.content:encoded: This unofficial Better Auth Nuxt demo should allow you to integrate your preferred database. It uses Tailwind 4, Nuxt 4, latest shadcn-vue, page protection and SQLite for login.

item.title: Generic Components for Vue 3
item.content:encoded: Generic components in Vue let you reuse a list without specifying what it will contain. Let’s see.

item.title: What Makes an Application Agentic?
item.content:encoded: With more autonomy than a predefined AI workflow, an agentic application uses AI to make decisions, plan and execute tasks, use tools and adapt its actions to achieve a goal with limited human input.

item.title: Build and Deploy a Dockerized NestJS Application on Google Cloud Run
item.content:encoded: Build an image for a NestJS project and deploy it on Google Cloud Platform and learn common tweaks and tips for updating and improving deployed services.

item.title: Blazor Basics: Introduction to Generic Type Support in Blazor
item.content:encoded: Learn the benefits of using generic type arguments using the @typeparam directive to implement reusable and type-safe Razor components.

item.title: 5 Agent Skills for Production Web Apps: Teach Your AI Coding Agent to Slow Down
item.content:encoded: Explore five Agent Skills, plus a bonus, that make AI coding agents act like 10x engineers.

item.title: Create a Cute Animal UI in .NET MAUI with Telerik UI Controls
item.content:encoded: Using a fun design, we’ll build an application user interface for learning animals in .NET MAUI. Progress Telerik UI for .NET MAUI will make it easy!

item.title: Is Convex Better Than Firebase?
item.content:encoded: Convex comes with setup complexity, especially for non-React developers, but after that offers a great UX with capacity to scale. Firebase is easy to set up and manage, but gets more complex when scaling.

item.title: How Do Software Development Teams Work?
item.content:encoded: Get a sense for how software development teams work together, what various roles are and how they coordinate workloads.

item.title: A Better v-model with defineModel
item.content:encoded: Rather than three separate pieces for a two-way bound value, defineModel gives this common Vue component pattern a single line of syntax.

item.content:encoded: Providing source attribution, explanations and transparency can help bolster user trust in an AI-powered application.
